_comment: TEMPLATE - not loaded automatically, and deliberately not bundled in the plugin.
Meta's OAuth client id is the Meta App ID of an app YOU control, so no value
shipped in this repository could be correct for you. See
Preferred: run the one-time command instead of editing JSON:
claude mcp add --transport http --client-id <YOUR_META_APP_ID> meta-ads https://mcp.facebook.com/ads
If you would rather edit config by hand, copy the meta-ads entry below into
your own .mcp.json and replace the client id. Remove these _comment keys.
